name: prompt-first
description: A safe agentic product studio for learning to direct and verify autonomous software builders

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p evals/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p .opencode/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun --cwd packages/studio-server typecheck && bun --cwd packages/web typecheck

scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
